verdict.rationale: Steel is open source and the steel-browser repo ships a pre-built Docker image (combined API + UI) that drives Chrome via Puppeteer/CDP. That lets a developer run a Steel browser instance on their own machine and connect with Puppeteer, Playwright, or Selenium. However, the documented agent integrations (AgentKit, AI SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK) are all described as running against Steel cloud sessions, and nothing explicitly confirms an account-free local development flow. Missing for 10: explicit docs on pointing agents/SDKs/CLI at a local instance, confirmation that no API key or cloud account is required, hands-on corroboration of local runs.
